scope: Actual original game update/physics/weapon/objective code; CPU fast-forward with ordinary HUD state refresh, no position/HP/outcome injection. Chromium initialization uses real WebGL2; any separately counted final screenshots also use that renderer; native desktop and touch-emulated UI controls are checked. Additional storage checks exercise a completed POW save and the actual Willard retry button, then explicitly invoke a failed retry debrief to verify isolation; that is not an additional mission success. Mission 11 receives up to 3,600 seconds of original update calls (360 batches) to allow a real offshore landing to reach capture and complete the camp and river route; other missions retain 1,800 seconds (180 batches). Not actual iPhone Safari, hardware FPS, or a full-speed screen recording.

verificationBudget.basis: The preserved 2200-second m11 proof physically reached custody, escaped the camp and continued downstream to 68,482m; the longer bound allows that progressing original route to finish.
